error.multiple_components: Multiple Avatar Texture Optimizer components found
error.multiple_components:description: Only one ATO component is allowed per avatar (on the object holding the VRCAvatarDescriptor). The build was aborted.
error.multiple_components:hint: Remove the extra components and build again.
error.no_descriptor: ATO component is not on the avatar root
error.no_descriptor:description: The Avatar Texture Optimizer component must be attached to the GameObject that has the VRCAvatarDescriptor. The build was aborted.
error.no_descriptor:hint: Move the component onto the avatar root object.
warn.unknown_shader:description: Reason: {1}. All textures referenced by this material were treated as whitelisted and left untouched for safety.
warn.unknown_shader:hint: This usually means the shader is not recognized or uses UV transforms. This is safe, just unoptimized.
warn.uv_out_of_bounds: UV islands of mesh '{0}' (uv{1}) cross a wrap seam
warn.uv_out_of_bounds:description: These UVs rely on repeat sampling and cannot be normalized into [0,1]. The affected textures were whitelisted and left untouched.
warn.uv_out_of_bounds:hint: This is safe; consider re-unwrapping the mesh if you want these textures optimized.
warn.island_too_big:description: Even alone it does not fit the largest allowed atlas. It was scaled as a standalone texture instead.
warn.island_too_big:hint: Increase the max density or accept the standalone scaling.
warn.gray_multichannel:description: A single-channel format was requested but the texture uses multiple channels; a multi-channel format was used instead to avoid data loss.
warn.gray_multichannel:hint: This is a safety fallback; no action needed.
report.title: Texture optimization finished: {0} atlases, -{6}% pixels
report.cancelled:description: The bake was cancelled by the user. Temporary assets on disk were kept; CPU/GPU/memory resources were released. The build was aborted.
ui.help.novice: Add this component to your avatar root and build - textures are analyzed, per-island scaled to the target quality and packed into atlases automatically. Defaults are safe for everyone; advanced options are folded below.
ui.q.tierhint: Values follow the selected preset. Choose Custom to edit them; Custom values are never overwritten by preset switching.
ui.whitelist.tip: Any object can be added (mesh, material, texture, animation, GameObject...). Every texture referenced by whitelisted objects is skipped by ALL optimizations.
